passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Consecrate to Me every firstborn male. The firstborn from every womb among the Israelites belongs to Me, both of man and beast.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD said, “Set apart every firstborn male for Me.
Every firstborn that opens the womb among the Israelites belongs to Me.
This includes both people and animals.
They are Mine.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ קַדֶּשׁ־ לִ֨י כָל־ בְּכ֜וֹר פֶּ֤טֶר כָּל־ רֶ֙חֶם֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָ֑ה לִ֖י הֽוּא׃

passages.text: So Moses told the people, “Remember this day, the day you came out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery; for the LORD brought you out of it by the strength of His hand. And nothing leavened shall be eaten.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the people.
He said, "Remember this day.
This is the day you came out of Egypt.
Egypt was the house of slavery.
The LORD brought you out of Egypt.
He used the strength of His hand.
Do not eat anything leavened."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל־ הָעָ֗ם זָכ֞וֹר אֶת־ הַיּ֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְצָאתֶ֤ם מִמִּצְרַ֙יִם֙ מִבֵּ֣ית עֲבָדִ֔ים כִּ֚י בְּחֹ֣זֶק יָ֔ד הוֹצִ֧יא יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִזֶּ֑ה וְלֹ֥א יֵאָכֵ֖ל חָמֵֽץ׃

passages.text: Today, in the month of Abib, you are leaving.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites are leaving Egypt today.
They are leaving slavery.
They are leaving in the month of Abib.
Abib is the first month of the year in the Hebrew calendar.
God is leading them out.
This is the day of their departure.
passages.original: הַיּ֖וֹם אַתֶּ֣ם יֹצְאִ֑ים בְּחֹ֖דֶשׁ הָאָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: And when the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Hivites, and Jebusites—the land He swore to your fathers that He would give you, a land flowing with milk and honey—you shall keep this service in this month.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD promised your fathers to give you a land.
This land belongs to the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
This land flows with milk and honey.
The LORD will bring you into this land.
When you enter this land, you must serve the LORD.
You must keep this service in this month.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֣ה כִֽי־ יְבִֽיאֲךָ֣ יְהוָ֡ה אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽ֠כְּנַעֲנִי וְהַחִתִּ֨י וְהָאֱמֹרִ֜י וְהַחִוִּ֣י וְהַיְבוּסִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֤ע לַאֲבֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ לָ֣תֶת לָ֔ךְ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָ֑שׁ וְעָבַדְתָּ֛ אֶת־ הָעֲבֹדָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: For seven days you are to eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day there shall be a feast to the LORD.
passages.sermon: God commanded the Israelites to eat unleavened bread for seven days.\r\nOn the seventh day, the Israelites must hold a feast for the LORD.
passages.original: שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים תֹּאכַ֣ל מַצֹּ֑ת וּבַיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י חַ֖ג לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Unleavened bread shall be eaten during those seven days. Nothing leavened may be found among you, nor shall leaven be found anywhere within your borders.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread.
Eat unleavened bread for seven days.
Do not let any leavened food be seen among you during these days.
Do not let any leaven be found anywhere within your borders.
passages.original: מַצּוֹת֙ יֵֽאָכֵ֔ל אֵ֖ת שִׁבְעַ֣ת הַיָּמִ֑ים וְלֹֽא־ יֵרָאֶ֨ה לְךָ֜ חָמֵ֗ץ וְלֹֽא־ יֵרָאֶ֥ה לְךָ֛ שְׂאֹ֖ר בְּכָל־ גְּבֻלֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: And on that day you are to explain to your son, ‘This is because of what the LORD did for me when I came out of Egypt.’
passages.sermon:
God rescued the Israelites from Egypt with great power.
God commanded the Israelites to eat unleavened bread for seven days.
God commanded the Israelites to celebrate a feast to Him on the seventh day.
God commanded the Israelites to remove all leaven from their homes and land during these days.
On that day, you must tell your son about these commands.
You must say to your son, “We do this because of what the LORD did for me when I came out of Egypt.”
passages.original: וְהִגַּדְתָּ֣ לְבִנְךָ֔ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא לֵאמֹ֑ר בַּעֲב֣וּר זֶ֗ה עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לִ֔י בְּצֵאתִ֖י מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: It shall be a sign for you on your hand and a reminder on your forehead that the Law of the LORD is to be on your lips. For with a mighty hand the LORD brought you out of Egypt.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God who brought you out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
You must remember what the LORD did for you.
You must keep the Law of the LORD on your lips.
You must have a sign on your hand.
You must have a reminder on your forehead.
These signs will help you remember the LORD’s Law.
The LORD saved you with great power.
passages.original: וְהָיָה֩ לְךָ֨ לְא֜וֹת עַל־ יָדְךָ֗ וּלְזִכָּרוֹן֙ בֵּ֣ין עֵינֶ֔יךָ לְמַ֗עַן תִּהְיֶ֛ה תּוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה בְּפִ֑יךָ כִּ֚י בְּיָ֣ד חֲזָקָ֔ה הוֹצִֽאֲךָ֥ יְהֹוָ֖ה מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Therefore you shall keep this statute at the appointed time year after year.
passages.sermon:
God gave this statute to His people.
God commanded you to keep this statute.
You must observe it at the appointed time.
You must do this every year.
You must not forget to keep it each year.
passages.original: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֛ אֶת־ הַחֻקָּ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את לְמוֹעֲדָ֑הּ מִיָּמִ֖ים יָמִֽימָה׃ס

passages.text: And after the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanites and gives it to you, as He swore to you and your fathers, you are to present to the LORD the firstborn male of every womb. All the firstborn males of your livestock belong to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD promised to give you the land of the Canaanites.
The LORD promised this land to you and to your fathers.
The LORD will bring you into this land.
The LORD will give this land to you.
You must give every firstborn male of every womb to the LORD.
You must give every firstborn male of your livestock to the LORD.
All firstborn males of your animals belong to the LORD.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֞ה כִּֽי־ יְבִֽאֲךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לְךָ֖ וְלַֽאֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ וּנְתָנָ֖הּ לָֽךְ׃ וְהַעֲבַרְתָּ֥ כָל־ פֶּֽטֶר־ רֶ֖חֶם לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה וְכָל־ פֶּ֣טֶר׀ שֶׁ֣גֶר בְּהֵמָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֛ הַזְּכָרִ֖ים לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: You must redeem every firstborn donkey with a lamb, and if you do not redeem it, you are to break its neck. And every firstborn of your sons you must redeem.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel laws after He brought them out of Egypt.
God commanded the people to give Him the firstborn males of their animals and sons.
You must redeem every firstborn donkey with a lamb.
If you do not redeem the donkey, you must break its neck.
You must redeem every firstborn son among your children.
passages.original: וְכָל־ פֶּ֤טֶר חֲמֹר֙ תִּפְדֶּ֣ה בְשֶׂ֔ה וְאִם־ לֹ֥א תִפְדֶּ֖ה וַעֲרַפְתּ֑וֹ וְכֹ֨ל בְּכ֥וֹר אָדָ֛ם בְּבָנֶ֖יךָ תִּפְדֶּֽה׃

passages.text: In the future, when your son asks you, ‘What does this mean?’ you are to tell him, ‘With a mighty hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God is powerful.
God rescued us from Egypt.
Egypt was a place of slavery.
God used His mighty hand to bring us out.
In the future, your son may ask you, “What does this mean?”
You must answer him.
You must say, “With a mighty hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.”
passages.original: וְהָיָ֞ה כִּֽי־ יִשְׁאָלְךָ֥ בִנְךָ֛ מָחָ֖ר לֵאמֹ֣ר מַה־ זֹּ֑את וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֔יו בְּחֹ֣זֶק יָ֗ד הוֹצִיאָ֧נוּ יְהוָ֛ה מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים׃

passages.text: And when Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, the LORD killed every firstborn in the land of Egypt, both of man and beast. This is why I sacrifice to the LORD the firstborn male of every womb, but I redeem all the firstborn of my sons.’
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh was the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let the Israelites go free.
The LORD is God.
The LORD killed every firstborn in the land of Egypt.
The LORD killed the firstborn of people.
The LORD killed the firstborn of animals.
This is why I sacrifice every firstborn male animal from the womb to the LORD.
I redeem every firstborn son.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י כִּֽי־ הִקְשָׁ֣ה פַרְעֹה֮ לְשַׁלְּחֵנוּ֒ וַיַּהֲרֹ֨ג יְהֹוָ֤ה כָּל־ בְּכוֹר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם מִבְּכֹ֥ר אָדָ֖ם וְעַד־ בְּכ֣וֹר בְּהֵמָ֑ה עַל־ כֵּן֩ אֲנִ֨י זֹבֵ֜חַ לַֽיהוָ֗ה כָּל־ פֶּ֤טֶר רֶ֙חֶם֙ הַזְּכָרִ֔ים וְכָל־ בְּכ֥וֹר בָּנַ֖י אֶפְדֶּֽה׃

passages.text: So it shall serve as a sign on your hand and a symbol on your forehead, for with a mighty hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD brought us out of Egypt.
The LORD used a mighty hand to save us.
This event must be remembered.
You must have a sign on your hand.
You must have a symbol on your forehead.
These remind you of what the LORD did.
The LORD rescued us from Egypt with great power.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֤ה לְאוֹת֙ עַל־ יָ֣דְכָ֔ה וּלְטוֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֣ין עֵינֶ֑יךָ כִּ֚י בְּחֹ֣זֶק יָ֔ד הוֹצִיאָ֥נוּ יְהוָ֖ה מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃ס

passages.text: When Pharaoh let the people go, God did not lead them along the road through the land of the Philistines, though it was shorter. For God said, “If the people face war, they might change their minds and return to Egypt.”
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh let the people of Israel go free from Egypt.
God did not lead the people along the road through the land of the Philistines.
The road through the Philistines’ land was shorter.
God chose not to take them that way.
God said, “If the people see war, they might change their minds.
They might return to Egypt.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י בְּשַׁלַּ֣ח פַּרְעֹה֮ אֶת־ הָעָם֒ וְלֹא־ נָחָ֣ם אֱלֹהִ֗ים דֶּ֚רֶךְ אֶ֣רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים כִּ֥י קָר֖וֹב ה֑וּא כִּ֣י׀ אָמַ֣ר אֱלֹהִ֗ים פֶּֽן־ יִנָּחֵ֥ם הָעָ֛ם בִּרְאֹתָ֥ם מִלְחָמָ֖ה וְשָׁ֥בוּ מִצְרָֽיְמָה׃

passages.text: So God led the people around by the way of the wilderness toward the Red Sea. And the Israelites left the land of Egypt arrayed for battle.
passages.sermon:
God led the people of Israel.
God did not take them on the shortest road.
God led them through the wilderness.
God led them toward the Red Sea.
The Israelites left Egypt.
The Israelites were prepared for battle.
passages.original: וַיַּסֵּ֨ב אֱלֹהִ֧ים׀ אֶת־ הָעָ֛ם דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַמִּדְבָּ֖ר יַם־ ס֑וּף וַחֲמֻשִׁ֛ים עָל֥וּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him because Joseph had made the sons of Israel swear a solemn oath when he said, “God will surely attend to you, and then you must carry my bones with you from this place.”
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Joseph was an important ancestor of the Israelites.
Moses took the bones of Joseph with him.
Joseph had made the sons of Israel swear an oath.
Joseph said, “God will surely take care of you.”
Joseph said, “You must carry my bones with you from this place.”
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־ עַצְמ֥וֹת יוֹסֵ֖ף עִמּ֑וֹ כִּי֩ הַשְׁבֵּ֨עַ הִשְׁבִּ֜יעַ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר פָּקֹ֨ד יִפְקֹ֤ד אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְהַעֲלִיתֶ֧ם אֶת־ עַצְמֹתַ֛י מִזֶּ֖ה אִתְּכֶֽם׃

passages.text: They set out from Succoth and camped at Etham on the edge of the wilderness.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites left Succoth.
They traveled together.
They stopped at Etham.
Etham was at the edge of the wilderness.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִסֻּכֹּ֑ת וַיַּחֲנ֣וּ בְאֵתָ֔ם בִּקְצֵ֖ה הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃

passages.text: And the LORD went before them in a pillar of cloud to guide their way by day, and in a pillar of fire to give them light by night, so that they could travel by day or night.
passages.sermon:
The LORD led the Israelites.
He went in front of them.
During the day, the LORD appeared in a pillar of cloud.
He used the cloud to guide their way.
At night, the LORD appeared in a pillar of fire.
He used the fire to give them light.
The LORD did this so the Israelites could travel by day.
He also did this so they could travel by night.
passages.original: וַֽיהוָ֡ה הֹלֵךְ֩ לִפְנֵיהֶ֨ם יוֹמָ֜ם בְּעַמּ֤וּד עָנָן֙ לַנְחֹתָ֣ם הַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וְלַ֛יְלָה בְּעַמּ֥וּד אֵ֖שׁ לְהָאִ֣יר לָהֶ֑ם לָלֶ֖כֶת יוֹמָ֥ם וָלָֽיְלָה׃

passages.text: Neither the pillar of cloud by day nor the pillar of fire by night left its place before the people.
passages.sermon:
God led the Israelites out of Egypt.
God used a pillar of cloud during the day.
God used a pillar of fire during the night.
The pillar of cloud stayed in front of the people during the day.
The pillar of fire stayed in front of the people during the night.
The pillar of cloud did not leave its place during the day.
The pillar of fire did not leave its place during the night.
God always stayed before the people.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ יָמִ֞ישׁ עַמּ֤וּד הֶֽעָנָן֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וְעַמּ֥וּד הָאֵ֖שׁ לָ֑יְלָה לִפְנֵ֖י הָעָֽם׃פ
